name: codegraph_stopping
description: Laya codegraph stopping gate. Fork of laya_mem stopping.json with code-specific question wording. Four noul judgments over the current evidence set; first-fail-on-CONTINUE implements AND-of-STOP — rules ordered contradiction > missing_evidence > evidence_sufficient so each CONTINUE_* label wins over the more general INSUFFICIENT one. The caller must set all four hint fields explicitly (evidence_status, missing_evidence, contradiction, continue_useful); the heuristic backend falls back to substring-matching the whole serialised state when a field is missing, which can cross-fire.

evidence_sufficient.instructions: Does the current `evidence` cover every part of `query` (entry point + call chain + supporting files) so a code-locating answer can be returned without guessing?
evidence_sufficient.truthy: Every claim has explicit code support.
evidence_sufficient.falsy: Any required symbol or file is unsupported; related files alone are insufficient.

continue_useful.instructions: Would another codegraph round (another caller hop, another FTS pass, a recent-changes lookup) fill a specific gap or resolve a conflict in the current `evidence`?
continue_useful.truthy: An identifiable gap or conflict could benefit from another retrieval.

missing_evidence.instructions: Is at least one symbol, file or call chain required by `query` absent from `evidence`?
missing_evidence.truthy: A required detail, file, qualified_name or call link is missing.
missing_evidence.falsy: All required facts have explicit support.

contradiction.instructions: Does `evidence` contain conflicting symbols, files or call chains that the supplied context cannot reconcile?
contradiction.truthy: A conflict still affects which answer is correct.
contradiction.falsy: Claims agree or differ only by explained updates.
